children: USD.AI has scheduled an unlock of at least 147.12 million CHIP for investors and team members in September 2027. The tokens due for release represent 7.36% of CHIP's circulating supply.

The unlock is part of CHIP's vesting schedule, which releases tokens in monthly batches. Once the tokens are released, the investors and team members who receive them can sell tokens that were previously locked.
